evals.name: design-managed-draft-rap-bo
evals.prompt: I'm building a new transactional travel app in ABAP Cloud. Outline a managed draft RAP BO with a validation and a service endpoint, including the main repository layers.
evals.expected_output: Describes the CDS data model, managed draft behavior definition and implementation, validation, projection/service definition/service binding layers, and keeps the design within released APIs for Level A.

evals.name: route-event-publishing-design
evals.prompt: When a RAP travel is accepted, I need to publish a business event to SAP Event Mesh. Focus on the event declaration, raising it, and event binding.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the core request is RAP business event publishing and routes to rap-business-events rather than treating it as ordinary RAP CRUD design.
